```{r}
install.packages('RColorBrewer')
```

```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)
```


```{r}
The_Climate_Change_Twitter_Dataset <- read_csv("C:\\Users\\kevin\\Documents\\GitHub\\Binghamton\\Harp 325\\Harp 325 Final\\The Climate Change Twitter Dataset.csv")
```
```{r}
TCCTD2009 <- The_Climate_Change_Twitter_Dataset %>% filter(created_at > "2009-10-01 16:06:42") %>% na.omit(The_Climate_Change_Twitter_Dataset) %>% select(-c(id))

TCCTD2009
```

```{r}
topicscc <- TCCTD2009 %>% count(topic) 
ggplot(topicscc, aes(x = topic, y = n, group = topic, fill = topic)) +
  geom_bar(stat="Identity") +
  labs(y = "Tweets", x = "Topics", 
       title = "Topic of Tweets, 2009-2019",
       color = "Topic")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = brewer.pal(n = 10, name = "RdBu"))+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
```
```{r}
topicscc <- TCCTD2009 %>% count(gender) 
ggplot(topicscc, aes(x = gender, y = n, group = gender, fill = gender)) +
  geom_bar(stat="Identity") +
  labs(y = "Tweets", x = "gender", 
       title = "Gender of Tweeters, 2009-2019",
       color = "Topic")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = brewer.pal(n = 3, name = "RdBu"))+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank())
```
```{r}
TCCTD2009$year <- str_extract(TCCTD2009$created_at, "[0-9]{4}")
genderdata <- TCCTD2009 %>% select(c("year", "gender")) 
```

```{r}
genderdata1 <- table(genderdata) %>% as.data.frame.matrix() 
genderdata1 <- cbind(year = rownames(genderdata1), genderdata1)
rownames(genderdata1) <- 1:nrow(genderdata1)
genderdata11 <- genderdata1 %>% mutate(percent_female = female/(female+male+undefined))
```

```{r}
genderdata2 <- genderdata1 %>% pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "Gender", values_to = "Tweets")
```


```{r}
options(scipen=999)
par(bg="beige")
ggplot(genderdata2, aes(x = year, y = Tweets, group = Gender, color = Gender)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(y = "Tweets", x = "Year", 
       title = "Tweets regarding Climate Change",
       color = "Gender")+
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'beige', color = 'black'))
```
```{r}
geodata <- TCCTD2009 %>% select(c("lng","lat", "stance"))
my_sf <- st_as_sf(geodata, coords = c('lng', 'lat'))

my_sf <- st_set_crs(my_sf, value=4979)
```

```{r}
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
world_map <- map_data("world")
ggplot(world_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group)) +
  geom_polygon(fill="lightgray", colour = "white")+
  geom_sf(data=my_sf, aes(color = stance),inherit.aes = FALSE)+
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
options(scipen=999)
par(mar = c(12, 7, 2, 0))
counts <- table(TCCTD2009$gender, TCCTD2009$topic)
colors <- c("red","blue","yellow")
par(bg="beige")
barplot(counts, beside=TRUE, legend=rownames(counts),
        main="Gender Distribution of Topic of Tweet, 2009-2019",
        ylab="Count",
        las=2,
        col=colors, xlab="Topic")

```

```{r}
counts1 <- counts %>% as.data.frame.matrix() 
counts1 <- cbind(gender = rownames(counts1), counts1)
rownames(counts1) <- 1:nrow(counts1)
counts2 <- counts1 %>% pivot_longer(-gender, names_to = "Topic", values_to = "Tweets")

ggplot(counts2, aes(x = Topic, y = Tweets, group = Topic, fill=gender)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  labs(y = "Tweets", x = "Topic", 
       title = "Distribution of Gender Versus Topic of Tweet, 2009-2019",
       color = "Topic")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red","blue","yellow"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), axis.text = element_text(size=8))
```
```{r}
counts3 <- counts2 %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = gender, values_from = Tweets) %>% mutate(percent_female = female/(female+male+undefined))
```




```{r}
par(mar = c(8, 7, 4, 0))
options(scipen=999)
aggressive_counts <- table(TCCTD2009$gender, TCCTD2009$aggressiveness)
colors <- c("red","blue","yellow")
x<-barplot(aggressive_counts, beside=TRUE, legend=rownames(counts),
        main="Aggressiveness vs Gender", xlab="Aggressiveness",las=1, col = colors)
```
```{r}
par(mar = c(8, 7, 4, 0))
options(scipen=999)
stance_counts <- table(TCCTD2009$gender, TCCTD2009$stance)
colors <- c("red","blue", "yellow")
x<-barplot(stance_counts, beside=TRUE, legend=rownames(counts), main="Stance vs Gender", xlab="Stance", las=1, col = colors)
```
